channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: When Desperation Meets the Vine
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on Psalm 28 and John 15, showing how moments of desperation become opportunities to abide in Christ, surrender our crises, and trust God to supply our needs.

item.title: Dollar Tree opens in Lanett, Valley store gets refurbished
item.description: Dollar Tree opens a new Lanett store in the former Colorvision building and refreshes its Valley location across from Walmart with a brighter, newly painted interior.

item.title: Freeman discusses efforts to support local nonprofit work
item.description: Development director Ben Freeman details how the East Alabama Community Foundation, now affiliated with Central Alabama Community Foundation, is boosting grants to local nonprofits.

item.title: Chambers County explores public transit
item.description: Chambers County is weighing an on-demand rural transit program to serve residents without vehicles, with officials studying costs, funding options and models used in other counties.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: Walking with Integrity in a World Full of Offers
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on Psalm 26 and 1 Timothy 6, urging Christians to walk with integrity, resist get-rich temptations, and trust Christ’s guidance among “wolves.”

item.title: FLM to host coat drive giveaway
item.description: Five Points-LaFayette-Milltown Alumni launches its first coat drive, collecting new and gently used coats and donations through March 7, with a focus on children in need.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Loran Smith: Ginkgo Tree
item.description: From Athens sidewalks to Hiroshima's blast zone, the ancient ginkgo biloba proves its resilience, beauty, and quirks—from foul-smelling females to dazzling golden fall canopies.

item.title: Annual sheriff’s fundraiser supports local Girls Ranch
item.description: Chambers County Sheriff’s annual Grillin’ for Girls steak fundraiser returns March 7 in Valley, raising money for Tallapoosa County Girls Ranch.

item.title: Valley Parks and Rec proposes an indoor play area
item.description: Valley Parks and Rec may turn underused racquetball courts into a “Riverlands” indoor playground, offering play for kids on hot, cold and rainy days if city leaders approve.

item.title: Chambers Academy defeats Springwood for state championship
item.description: Chambers Academy edged rival Springwood 45-41 to claim the AISA 2A boys state title in a historic state championship meeting between the two teams.
